verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe an AI/agent 'Describe segment' feature that converts plain-text descriptions into a real segment (docs-31), backed by a documented MCP server/CLI giving agents programmatic access to workspace features including segments (docs-9, docs-27, docs-26). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that the natural-language-to-segment translation works reliably in practice, and more detail on the exact programmatic API call used for segment creation.
